notes:
- New: a connection indicator beside the address bar shows at a glance whether the browser is online — green for a good connection, orange when it is slow or unstable, red when it drops.
- New: when an update is ready, an update icon appears beside the address bar; click it to download and then restart to update. The old dot on the Settings icon is gone.
- The Downloads button is now hidden when downloads are turned off for your session.
- The Ctrl+Alt+Del screen again offers Shut down and Restart (Sleep and Hibernate stay hidden).
- New exam mode ("Hide sidebar"): a single tab with no sidebar, for a distraction-free exam. Your administrator turns this on.
- Stronger exam protection: detects more remote-control and screen-recording tools, a program's window covering the exam, a duplicated (mirrored) screen, and touchpad edge/gesture shortcuts are switched off during a session.
- Fixes a problem where quitting with the exit password was recorded as a crash.
